metas.name: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
metas.description: SpongeBob takes leave from Bikini Bottom in order to track down, with Patrick, King Neptune's stolen crown.

metas.name: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
metas.description: When a diabolical pirate above the sea steals the secret Krabby Patty formula, SpongeBob and his friends team up in order to get it back.

metas.name: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run
metas.description: After SpongeBob's beloved pet snail Gary is snail-napped, he and Patrick embark on an epic adventure to the Lost City of Atlantic City to bring Gary home.

metas.name: Ben 10: Secret of the Omnitrix
metas.description: When the Omnitrix begins a countdown to self-destruction, Ben and Gwen team up with Tetrax to find the watch's creator before it's too late.

metas.name: Ben 10: Race Against Time
metas.description: Ben Tennyson returns home from summer vacation only to discover that a rapidly aging alien criminal named, Eon, is planning to use an ancient alien artifact to destroy Bellwood.

metas.name: Ben 10: Alien Swarm
metas.description: Against his grandfather's orders, Ben Tennyson teams up with the daughter of an old enemy in order to prevent an alien infestation of earth.

metas.name: Ben 10: Destroy All Aliens
metas.description: While dealing with the end of summer vacation and a critically damaged Omnitrix, Ben Tennyson finds himself targeted by a mysterious alien bounty hunter.

metas.name: Ben 10 vs. the Universe: The Movie
metas.description: A blast from Ben's past returns to do double the damage on Team Tennyson and planet Earth itself, forcing Ben to go interstellar to save the day.

metas.name: Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back
metas.description: Scientists genetically create a new Pokémon, Mewtwo, but the results are horrific and disastrous.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie 2000
metas.description: Ash Ketchum must gather the three spheres of fire, ice and lightning in order to restore balance to the Orange Islands.

metas.name: Pokémon 3 the Movie: Spell of the Unown
metas.description: In the town of Greenfield, a young, lonely girl's dreams and wishes are brought into reality by a collective of reality-warping Pokémon.

metas.name: Pokemon 4Ever: Celebi - Voice of the Forest
metas.description: Ash must stop a hunter who forces the mythical Pokémon Celebi to help him destroy a forest.

metas.name: Pokémon Heroes
metas.description: Two thieves take control of an ancient weapon designed to defend the canal city of Altomare.

metas.name: Pokémon: Jirachi - Wish Maker
metas.description: A magician attempts to use the power of the Millennium Comet to awaken the legendary Pokémon Groudon.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Destiny Deoxys
metas.description: A comet bearing a deadly Pokemon creature crash-lands onto Earth, terrorising a nearby high-tech city, where Ash, Pikachu and friends are currently visiting...

metas.name: Pokémon: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew
metas.description: When Pikachu is taken to the Tree of Beginnings by the playful Mew, Ash Ketchum and friends are guided to the tree by Lucario, a time-displaced Pokémon who seeks answers regarding the betrayal of his master.

metas.name: Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea
metas.description: Our heroes must protect the Prince of the Sea, Manaphy, from the evil pirate Phantom, and return the young Pokémon to the Sea Temple with the help of the the People of the Water and Jackie the Pokémon Ranger.

metas.name: Pokémon: The Rise of Darkrai
metas.description: An idyllic town is thrown into chaos when two powerful Pokémon, Dialga and Palkia, cross paths and battle, distorting the dimensions of time and space. The only hope comes from Darkrai, a shadowy Pokémon shunned by the townsfolk.

metas.name: Pokémon: Giratina and the Sky Warrior
metas.description: When a new Pokèmon emerges able to create parallel dimensions, it's up to Ash Ketchum and his friends to stop a mysterious stranger from using its powers for evil!

metas.name: Pokémon: Arceus and the Jewel of Life
metas.description: Arceus, creator of the world, comes to pass judgement on humanity for the theft of the Jewel of Life, but Ash Ketchum and his friends are sent back in time to discover and possible reverse the events that led to Arceus' vendetta.

metas.name: Pokémon: Zoroark: Master of Illusions
metas.description: A greedy, manipulative media mogul seeks to capture Celebi for nefarious purposes, using the shape-shifting Pokémon Zoroark to hunt it down.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Black - Victini and Reshiram
metas.description: Victini, a legendary Pokémon, unable to leave the boundaries of its hometown, is targeted by a determined villager to restore the homelands of his ancestors.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: White - Victini and Zekrom
metas.description: The greatest adventure in Pokémon history approaches.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Kyurem vs. the Sword of Justice
metas.description: An over zealous pokemon called Keldeo enrages a very powerful Kyurem. With the help of Ash and Pikachu, can Keldeo become a sword of justice and defeat the mighty Kyurem?

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Genesect and the Legend Awakened
metas.description: Ash, Pikachu, and friends must stop a group of Genesect from the destroying the city with the help of Mewtwo.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction
metas.description: When Diancie a Pokémon said to create diamond travels to find Xerneas to help her make a heart diamond to save her home, Ash, Serena, Clemont and Bonnie help her to be safe on the way from thieves.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Hoopa and the Clash of Ages
metas.description: Ash, Pikachu, and their friends meet the mythical Pokémon Hoopa. The little Pokémon likes to use his talent to play harmless tricks on people. When its true power is released, it loses control and becomes the terrifying Hoopa Unbo...

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel
metas.description: A mystical Pokémon by the name of Volcanion must accept Ash's help to rescue the Azoth Kingdom.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!
metas.description: Ash Ketchum from Pallet Town is 10 years old today. This means he is now old enough to become a Pokémon Trainer. Ash dreams big about the adventures he will experience after receiving his first Pokémon from Professor Oak.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us
metas.description: Ash meets five residents who come together to save the day when a series of threats endanger the annual Wind Festival and the entire population of their home, Fula City

metas.name: Pokémon: Mewtwo Strikes Back - Evolution
metas.description: After a scientific experiment leads to the creation of a clone of Mewtwo, he sets out to destroy the world. Ash and his friends then decide to thwart Mewtwo's evil plans.

metas.name: Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle
metas.description: The story of Koko, a young boy raised by Pokémon, and the creation of a new bond between humans and Pokémon.

metas.name: Digimon: The Movie
metas.description: Throughout three different stories, Kari Kamiya and her friends take on explosive adventures involving digital creatures.

metas.name: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Movie
metas.description: Underneath the sands of Egypt, Anubis, an ancient evil spirit, has awakened. It's up to Yugi, who defeated Anubis centuries ago, to use his skill and determination to rid the world of evil once again.

metas.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Bonds Beyond Time
metas.description: Yugi, Jaden and Yusei must travel through time and team up to save a children's card game.

metas.name: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Dark Side of Dimensions
metas.description: Yugi and Kaiba have a special duel that transcends dimensions.

metas.name: Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods
metas.description: After sleeping for 39 years, the God of destruction Beerus is surprised to learn that Frieza was defeated by the saiyajin Goku. Upon finding him, Goku is excited to face him, but realizes that his powers are negligible compared to...

metas.name: Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection 'F'
metas.description: Frieza is reborn and achieves the last of his transformations, and it is up to Goku and his warrior friends to join forces to fight the enemy who has returned from the dead.

metas.name: Dragon Ball Super: Broly
metas.description: Goku and Vegeta encounter Broly, a Saiyan warrior unlike any fighter they've faced before.

metas.name: Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero
metas.description: The Red Ribbon Army from Goku's past has returned with two new androids to challenge him and his friends.

metas.name: Phineas and Ferb the Movie: Across the 2nd Dimension
metas.description: Phineas and Ferb discover that Perry is a secret agent and they all get stuck in an alternate dimension where Doofenschmirtz is the ruler of the tri-state area.

metas.name: Phineas and Ferb the Movie: Candace Against the Universe
metas.description: The famed stepbrother inventors know what they're gonna do today. They're gonna rescue their sister from an alien abduction.

metas.name: The Powerpuff Girls Movie
metas.description: After destroying the city of Townsville in a game of tag, a trio of super-powered little girls must redeem themselves by stopping a vengeful monkey's plot for world domination.

metas.name: Ed, Edd n Eddy's Big Picture Show
metas.description: When a scam goes horribly wrong and leaves the neighborhood kids furious, the Eds embark on a journey to find Eddy's brother to save them from their consequences in the "Ed, Edd, n Eddy" series finale.

metas.name: Steven Universe: The Movie
metas.description: Steven thinks his time defending the Earth is over, but when a new threat comes to Beach City, Steven faces his biggest challenge yet.

metas.name: We Bare Bears: The Movie
metas.description: Grizz, Panda, and Ice Bear embark on an adventure to Canada after an agent from the Department of National Wildlife Control tries to put an end to their hi-jinx.

metas.name: Billy & Mandy's Big Boogey Adventure
metas.description: When the Boogey Man causes Grim to lose his powers, rank, and title in the Underworld Court for misusing his powers, he plots to seek out Horror's Hand and take over the world. It's up to Billy, Mandy, Irwin, and Grim to get to Ho...

metas.name: Codename: Kids Next Door - Operation Z.E.R.O.
metas.description: The knd must find a way to stop grandfather from ruling the world and turning everyone including adults into senior citizen zombies. Meanwhile numbuh one finds out his loser dad was the great numbuh zero.

metas.name: Regular Show: The Movie
metas.description: To save the universe, and their friendship, Mordecai and Rigby must defeat an evil volleyball coach.

metas.name: Teen Titans: Trouble in Tokyo
metas.description: After a battle with a high-tech villain, the Teen Titans travel to the city of Tokyo where they find themselves embroiled in a conflict with an ancient enemy.

metas.name: Teen Titans GO! To the Movies
metas.description: A villain's maniacal plan for world domination gets in the way of the Teen Titans' dream of superhero stardom in Hollywood.

metas.name: Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius
metas.description: An eight-year-old boy genius and his friends must rescue their parents after the adults are abducted by aliens.

metas.name: Jimmy Timmy Power Hour
metas.description: Mayhem reigns supreme in the animated kingdom as whiz kid Jimmy Neutron and Timmy from "The Fairly Oddparents" swap places in each other's worlds.

metas.name: Jimmy Timmy Power Hour 2: When Nerds Collide
metas.description: Cartoon worlds collide in this hourlong adventure starring whiz kid Jimmy Neutron and Timmy Turner from "The Fairly OddParents." When the boys duel over Cindy Vortex, it draws the attention of Jimmy's archenemy, Prof. Calamitous, who teams with Wanda and Cosmo, forcing Jimmy and Timmy to work together to save the world from the all-powerful villain.

metas.name: Jimmy Timmy Power Hour 3: The Jerkinators!
metas.description: Back for their third and zaniest adventure yet, Nickelodeon's boy genius Jimmy Neutron and Timmy from "The Fairly Odd Parents" unite to sculpt a wonder robot. Cartoon calamity ensues when the power-hungry robot develops a mind of his own and turns on his creative inventors.

metas.name: The Fairly OddParents Abra Catastrophe!
metas.description: Timmy uses a powerful rule-free magic muffin for wishes, but then Timmy's evil insane teacher Mr. Crocker gets it, traps Wanda and uses her power to rule the universe.

metas.name: The Fairly OddParents: Channel Chasers
metas.description: After being punished with no more television for the rest of his life, Timmy wishes himself into the world of television in order to escape the harsh reality of his life and his parents. Unfortunately for him, his carelessness with magic results in Vicky taking over the world in the future. It's all up to Timmy to stop her in attempts to prevent her from destroying Dimmsdale, while escaping a mysterious masked man that is trying to track him down.

metas.name: The Rugrats Movie
metas.description: The babies gets lost in the forest after Tommy Pickles gets a new baby brother.

metas.name: Rugrats in Paris
metas.description: While on a family vacation in Paris, the Rugrats attempt to help Chuckie find a new mom while stopping his dad from marrying a conniving businesswoman who hates kids.

metas.name: Rugrats Go Wild
metas.description: The Rugrats get tangled in an exotic adventure, where they're helped by the Thornberrys, a family that travels the world making nature documentaries.

metas.name: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
metas.description: After losing a cheetah cub to ruthless poachers, Eliza must redeem her folly and go on a quest to save him.

metas.name: Hey Arnold! The Movie
metas.description: Arnold and company must recover a stolen document needed in order to prevent Hillwood from being bulldozed. So, Arnold and Gerald was risk their life to save their neighborhood in the nick of time.

metas.name: Hey Arnold: The Jungle Movie
metas.description: Picking up where Hey Arnold! (1996) left off, this tells the story of what happened to Arnold's parents.

metas.name: Recess: School's Out
metas.description: T.J. and the gang must save summer vacation from disappearing forever.

metas.name: Kim Possible: A Sitch in Time
metas.description: The new school year starts off terrible for Kim. In her ordinary life her best friend is moving away, and in her heroic crime-fighting life, three of the most notorious villains in her world plan to use time travel as a weapon aga...

metas.name: Kim Possible: So the Drama
metas.description: Kim's heart is quickly captured by the new boy, Eric, who soon becomes her boyfriend. Unknown to Kim, her best friend and sidekick, Ron has developed stronger feelings toward her.

metas.name: DuckTales: The Movie - Treasure of the Lost Lamp
metas.description: Scrooge McDuck takes Huey, Dewey, and Louie to Egypt to find a pyramid and magic lamp.

metas.name: A Goofy Movie
metas.description: When Max makes a preposterous promise to a girl he has a crush on, his chances to fulfilling it seem hopeless when he is dragged onto a cross-country trip with his embarrassing father, Goofy.

metas.name: An Extremely Goofy Movie
metas.description: Max goes to college, but to his embarassment his father loses his job and goes to his son's campus.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo on Zombie Island
metas.description: The Mystery Gang reunite and visit Moonscar Island, a remote island with a dark secret. Daphne wants more than just a villain in a costume, and they get more than they ever expected.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo and the Witch's Ghost
metas.description: Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Gang visit Oakhaven, Massachusetts to seek strange goings on involving a famous horror novelist and his ancestor who is rumored be a witch.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo and the Alien Invaders
metas.description: A cosmic case of flying saucers, intergalactic intrigue and out-of-this-world romance launches Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Gang into their most unearthly adventure ever.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo and the Cyber Chase
metas.description: When Scooby and the gang get trapped in a video game created for them, they must fight against the 'Phantom Virus'. To escape the game they must go level by level and defeat the game once and for all.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo and the Legend of the Vampire
metas.description: The gang go to Australia to investigate the recent disappearances of the performances at the music festivals, by the so called 'Yowie Yahoo'.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo and the Monster of Mexico
metas.description: Join Scooby, Shaggy and the gang as they visit a friend in Mexico to celebrate the Day of the Dead! Only this time it's a monster that terrorizes the town.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo! Pirates Ahoy!
metas.description: Arrgh. It's horror on the high seas when Scooby-Doo and the gang take a creepy cruise into one of the world's most mysterious places - the legendary Bermuda Triangle.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo! Abracadabra-Doo
metas.description: The gang goes on a trip to check on Velma's younger sister, Madelyn. She's been studying stage magic at the Whirlen Merlin Magic Academy, where apparently there have been sightings of a giant griffin. The gang decides to investigate.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo! Camp Scare
metas.description: Scooby-Doo, Shaggy, Freddy, Daphne and Velma fish for clues to solve the mysteries of The Woodsman, The Fishman and The Banshee of Black Canyon.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo! Legend of the Phantosaur
metas.description: When the Scooby Doo gang encounters the horrible Phantosaur, they investigate to find out what's really behind this prehistoric haunting.

metas.name: Scooby-Doo! Stage Fright
metas.description: Daphne and Fred try out for a talent show that takes place in an old opera house, but the show may be cancelled before rehearsals when a masked Phantom re-appears from the past.

metas.name: Scoob!
metas.description: Scooby and the gang face their most challenging mystery ever: a plot to unleash the ghost dog Cerberus upon the world. As they race to stop this dogpocalypse, the gang discovers that Scooby has an epic destiny greater than anyone ...

metas.name: Tom and Jerry: The Magic Ring
metas.description: Tom is left in charge of a priceless magical ring by his young wizard master. He is then horrified when the ring gets stuck on Jerry's head, who then runs off into the city.

metas.name: Tom and Jerry Blast Off to Mars!
metas.description: While carrying on their usual chases, Tom and Jerry inadvertently stow-away on a spaceship bound for Mars.

metas.name: Tom and Jerry: The Fast and the Furry
metas.description: After wrecking their house during a chase, Tom and Jerry enter a race around the world where the winner gets a new fancy house.

metas.name: Tom and Jerry in Shiver Me Whiskers
metas.description: A cat and a mouse must outsmart a band of pirates to find buried treasure.

metas.name: Tom and Jerry: A Nutcracker Tale
metas.description: Tom and his army of stray cats take over Jerry's magical kingdom of living toys. Chased by Tom and his cronies, Jerry must find the Toymaker and get help to win his kingdom back before sunrise when the window of opportunity closes.

metas.name: Tom and Jerry Meet Sherlock Holmes
metas.description: Miss Red is being blackmailed. When she asks Sherlock Holmes for help, he connects her case to a series of jewel thefts and tells his assistant Jerry the Mouse to work with Red's butler Tom the Cat for the duration of this case.

metas.name: Batman: Mask of the Phantasm
metas.description: Batman is wrongly implicated in a series of murders of mob bosses actually committed by a new vigilante assassin.

metas.name: Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker
metas.description: The Joker is back with a vengeance, and Gotham's newest Dark Knight needs answers as he stands alone to face Gotham's most infamous Clown Prince of Crime.

metas.name: The Batman vs. Dracula
metas.description: Batman faces off against the original creature of the night, Count Dracula, who has been unintentionally resurrected by the Penguin.

metas.name: Batman: Under the Red Hood
metas.description: There's a mystery afoot in Gotham City, and Batman must go toe-to-toe with a mysterious vigilante, who goes by the name of Red Hood. Subsequently, old wounds reopen and old, once buried memories come into the light.

metas.name: Batman: Assault on Arkham
metas.description: Batman works desperately to find a bomb planted by the Joker while Amanda Waller hires her newly formed Suicide Squad to break into Arkham Asylum to recover vital information stolen by the Riddler.

metas.name: Superman/Batman: Public Enemies
metas.description: When Lex Luthor gets elected US President, he uses the threat of an oncoming kryptonite meteor striking Earth as a rationale to frame Superman.

metas.name: Justice League: Crisis on Two Earths
metas.description: A good version of Lex Luthor from a parallel Earth comes to the Justice League's dimension for help to fight their evil counterparts.

metas.name: Justice League: Doom
metas.description: Vandal Savage steals confidential files Batman has compiled on the members of the Justice League, and learns all their weaknesses.

metas.name: Justice League: The Flashpoint Paradox
metas.description: The Flash finds himself in a war torn alternate timeline and teams up with alternate versions of his fellow heroes to return home and restore the timeline.

metas.name: Justice League: War
metas.description: The world's finest heroes found the Justice League in order to stop an alien invasion of Earth.

metas.name: Justice League Dark
metas.description: Beings with supernatural powers join together to fight against supernatural villains. This team of supernatural beings include John Constantine, Zatanna and Jason Blood also known as the demon Etrigan.

metas.name: Justice League Dark: Apokolips War
metas.description: A Sequel to Justice League Dark (2017) involving Jack Kirby's New Gods.

metas.name: The Death of Superman
metas.description: Superman battles against an insurmountable foe named Doomsday.

metas.name: Reign of the Supermen
metas.description: After the death of Superman, several new people present themselves as possible successors.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe and must join with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all realities.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
metas.description: Traveling across the multiverse, Miles Morales meets a new team of Spider-People, made up of heroes from different dimensions. But when the heroes clash over how to deal with a new threat, Miles finds himself at a crossroads.

metas.name: Ultimate Avengers: The Movie
metas.description: To confront an alien menace, General Fury assembles a team of superheroes lead by a recently resuscitated Captain America.

metas.name: Planet Hulk
metas.description: The Incredible Hulk, ejected from Earth in a spaceship, crash-lands on a planet ruled by a tyrant, who forces him to fight in a coliseum against other powerful creatures. The Hulk reluctantly befriends the combatants on his team.

metas.name: The Transformers: The Movie
metas.description: The Autobots must stop a colossal planet-consuming robot who goes after the Autobot Matrix of Leadership. At the same time, they must defend themselves against an all-out attack from the Decepticons.

metas.name: TMNT
metas.description: When the world is threatened by an ancient evil, the Ninja Turtles must reunite and overcome their faults in order to stand against it.

metas.name: Turtles Forever
metas.description: The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles meet their match -- Literally! The modern, gritty Ninja Turtles must team up with their classic cartoon counterparts to stop two Shredders and their plans of multi-dimensional scale.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: An ordinary LEGO construction worker, thought to be the prophesied as "special", is recruited to join a quest to stop an evil tyrant from gluing the LEGO universe into eternal stasis.

metas.name: The Lego Movie 2: The Second Part
metas.description: It's been five years since everything was awesome and the citizens are facing the huge new threat of Lego Duplo, invaders from outer space, wrecking everything faster than they can rebuild.

metas.name: The Lego Batman Movie
metas.description: A cooler-than-ever Bruce Wayne must deal with the usual suspects as they plan to rule Gotham City, while discovering that he has accidentally adopted a teenage orphan who wishes to become his sidekick.

metas.name: Toy Story
metas.description: A cowboy doll is profoundly jealous when a new spaceman action figure supplants him as the top toy in a boy's bedroom. When circumstances separate them from their owner, the duo have to put aside their differences to return to him.

metas.name: Toy Story 2
metas.description: When Woody is stolen by a toy collector, Buzz and his friends set out on a rescue mission to save Woody before he becomes a museum toy property with his roundup gang Jessie, Prospector, and Bullseye.

metas.name: Toy Story 3
metas.description: As Andy prepares to leave for college, Woody, Buzz and the gang face an uncertain future when a mix-up sends them to a daycare center full of new toys.

metas.name: Toy Story 4
metas.description: When Woody, Buzz, and the gang join Bonnie on a road trip with her new craft project turned toy, Forky, the innocent little spork's antics launch Woody on a wild quest.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: While trying to lead a quiet suburban life, a family of undercover superheroes are forced into action to save the world.

metas.name: Incredibles 2
metas.description: The Incredibles family takes on a new mission which involves a change in family roles: Bob Parr (Mr. Incredible) must manage the house while his wife Helen (Elastigirl) goes out to save the world.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: Two monsters whose job is to make human children scream accidentally let a little girl into their world and must now protect her from their own kind to return her home unscathed.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: A look at the relationship between Mike Wazowski and James P. "Sully" Sullivan during their days at Monsters University, when they weren't necessarily the best of friends.

metas.name: Finding Nemo
metas.description: After his son is captured in the Great Barrier Reef and taken to Sydney, a timid clownfish sets out on a journey to bring him home.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: Friendly but forgetful blue tang Dory begins a search for her long-lost parents and everyone learns a few things about the real meaning of family along the way.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: On the way to the biggest race of his life, a hotshot rookie race car gets stranded in a rundown town and learns that winning isn't everything in life.

metas.name: Cars 2
metas.description: Star race car Lightning McQueen and his pal Mater head overseas to compete in the World Grand Prix race. But the road to the championship becomes rocky as Mater gets caught up in an intriguing adventure of his own: international e...

metas.name: Cars 3
metas.description: Lightning McQueen sets out to prove to a new generation of racers that he's still the best race car in the world.

metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: After a young girl is uprooted from her Midwest life and moved to San Francisco, her emotions conflict on how best to navigate her new reality.

metas.name: Inside Out 2
metas.description: A sequel that features Riley entering puberty and experiencing brand new, more complex emotions as a result. As Riley tries to adapt to her teenage years, her old emotions try to adapt to the possibility of being replaced.

metas.name: A Bug's Life
metas.description: A misfit ant, looking for "warriors" to save his colony from greedy grasshoppers, recruits a group of bugs that turn out to be an inept circus troupe.

metas.name: Ratatouille
metas.description: A rat who can cook makes an unusual alliance with a young kitchen worker at a famous Paris restaurant.

metas.name: WALL·E
metas.description: In a future where humans have temporarily abandoned Earth, a trash-compacting robot falls in love with a flying droid and helps her on her quest to restore hope to mankind.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A grumpy old man turns his house into an airship using balloons and flies off to South America with a young stowaway.

metas.name: Coco
metas.description: Aspiring musician Miguel, confronted with his family's ancestral ban on music, enters the Land of the Dead to find his great-great-grandfather, a legendary singer.

metas.name: Shrek
metas.description: A mean lord exiles fairytale creatures to the swamp of a grumpy ogre, who must go on a quest and rescue a princess for the lord in order to get his land back.

metas.name: Shrek 2
metas.description: Shrek and Fiona travel to the Kingdom of Far Far Away, where Fiona's parents are King and Queen, to celebrate their marriage. When they arrive, they find they are not as welcome as they thought they would be.

metas.name: Shrek the Third
metas.description: Reluctantly designated as the heir to the land of Far, Far Away, Shrek hatches a plan to install the rebellious Artie as the new king while Princess Fiona tries to fend off a coup d'état by the jilted Prince Charming.

metas.name: Shrek Forever After
metas.description: Rumpelstiltskin tricks a mid-life crisis burdened Shrek into allowing himself to be erased from existence and cast in a dark alternate timeline where Rumpelstiltskin rules supreme.

metas.name: Puss in Boots
metas.description: An outlaw cat, his childhood egg-friend, and a seductive thief kitty set out in search for the eggs of the fabled Golden Goose to clear his name, restore his lost honor, and regain the trust of his mother and town.

metas.name: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
metas.description: When Puss in Boots discovers that his passion for adventure has taken its toll and he has burned through eight of his nine lives, he launches an epic journey to restore them by finding the mythical Last Wish.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda
metas.description: To everyone's surprise, including his own, Po, an overweight, clumsy panda, is chosen as protector of the Valley of Peace. His suitability will soon be tested as the valley's arch-enemy is on his way.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 2
metas.description: Po and his friends fight to stop a peacock villain from conquering China with a deadly new weapon, but first the Dragon Warrior must come to terms with his past.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: Continuing his "legendary adventures of awesomeness", Po must face two hugely epic, but different threats: one supernatural and the other a little closer to home.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 4
metas.description: After Po is tapped to become the Spiritual Leader of the Valley of Peace, he needs to find and train a new Dragon Warrior, while a wicked sorceress plans to re-summon all the master villains whom Po has vanquished to the spirit re...

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A hapless young Viking who aspires to hunt dragons becomes the unlikely friend of a young dragon himself, and learns there may be more to the creatures than he assumed.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
metas.description: When Hiccup and Toothless discover an ice cave that is home to hundreds of new wild dragons and the mysterious Dragon Rider, the two friends find themselves at the center of a battle to protect the peace.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
metas.description: When Hiccup discovers Toothless isn't the only Night Fury, he must seek the Hidden World, a secret Dragon Utopia before a hired tyrant named Grimmel finds it first.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A group of animals who have spent all their life in a New York zoo end up in the jungles of Madagascar, and must adjust to living in the wild.

metas.name: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa
metas.description: The Madagascar animals fly back to New York City, but crash-land on an African nature reserve in Kenya, where they meet others of their own kind, and Alex especially discovers his royal heritage as prince of a lion pride.

metas.name: Madagascar 3: Europe's Most Wanted
metas.description: The Madagascar animals join a struggling European circus to get back to New York, but find themselves being pursued by a psychotic animal-control officer.

metas.name: Penguins of Madagascar
metas.description: Skipper, Kowalski, Rico, and Private join forces with the secret organization North Wind in an effort to stop a terrible villain from wiping out all the penguins in the world.

metas.name: The Croods
metas.description: In the primeval era, Grug and his family risk the dangers of their surroundings to find a new dwelling place. Along the way, they meet a modern boy who woos them with his adventurous ways.

metas.name: The Croods: A New Age
metas.description: The prehistoric family the Croods are challenged by a rival family the Bettermans, who claim to be better and more evolved.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: The villainous Megamind finally defeats his do-gooder nemesis, Metro Man, but is left without a purpose in a superhero-free world.

metas.name: Over the Hedge
metas.description: A scheming raccoon fools a mismatched family of forest creatures into helping him repay a debt of food, by invading the new suburban sprawl that popped up while they were hibernating...and learns a lesson about family himself.

metas.name: Flushed Away
metas.description: The story of an uptown rat that gets flushed down the toilet from his penthouse apartment, ending in the sewers of London, where he has to learn a whole new and different way of life.

metas.name: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
metas.description: Wallace and his loyal dog, Gromit, set out to discover the mystery behind the garden sabotage that plagues their village and threatens the annual giant vegetable growing contest.

metas.name: Chicken Run
metas.description: When a cockerel apparently flies into a chicken farm, the chickens see him as an opportunity to escape their evil owners.

metas.name: The Prince of Egypt
metas.description: Egyptian Prince Moses learns of his identity as a Hebrew and his destiny to become the chosen deliverer of his people.

metas.name: The Road to El Dorado
metas.description: Two swindlers get their hands on a map to the fabled city of gold, El Dorado.

metas.name: Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron
metas.description: A captured mustang remains determined to return to his herd no matter what.

metas.name: Shark Tale
metas.description: When a son of a gangster shark boss is accidentally killed while on the hunt, his would-be prey and his vegetarian brother decide to use the incident to their own advantage.

metas.name: Bee Movie
metas.description: Barry B. Benson, a bee just graduated from college, is disillusioned at his lone career choice: making honey. On a special trip outside the hive, Barry's life is saved by Vanessa, a florist in New York City. As their relationship ...

metas.name: Monsters vs. Aliens
metas.description: A woman transformed into a giant after she is struck by a meteorite on her wedding day becomes part of a team of monsters sent in by the U.S. government to defeat an alien mastermind trying to take over Earth.

metas.name: Rise of the Guardians
metas.description: When the evil spirit Pitch launches an assault on Earth, the Immortal Guardians team up to protect the innocence of children all around the world.

metas.name: Ice Age
metas.description: Manny the mammoth, Sid the loquacious sloth, and Diego the sabre-toothed tiger go on a comical quest to return a human baby back to his father, across a world on the brink of an ice age.

metas.name: Ice Age: The Meltdown
metas.description: Manny, Sid and Diego discover that the ice age is coming to an end, and join everybody for a journey to higher ground. On the trip, they discover that Manny is not in fact the last of the woolly mammoths.

metas.name: Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs
metas.description: When Sid's attempt to adopt three dinosaur eggs gets him abducted by their real mother to an underground lost world, his friends attempt to rescue him.

metas.name: Ice Age: Continental Drift
metas.description: Manny, Diego, and Sid embark upon another adventure after their continent is set adrift. Using an iceberg as a ship, they encounter sea creatures and battle pirates as they explore a new world.

metas.name: Ice Age: Collision Course
metas.description: When Scrat's acorn sends an asteroid to Earth, the Herd must find a way to stop the asteroid from hitting Earth with the help of a returning friend.

metas.name: Despicable Me
metas.description: Gru, a criminal mastermind, adopts three orphans as pawns to carry out the biggest heist in history. His life takes an unexpected turn when the little girls see the evildoer as their potential father.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: When a new criminal comes to town, the Anti-Villain League decides to hire Gru in order to fight him off. While Gru initially refuses, he eventually agrees after his aide goes back to his evil ways.

metas.name: Despicable Me 3
metas.description: Gru meets his long-lost, charming, cheerful, and more successful twin brother Dru, who wants to team up with him for one last criminal heist.

metas.name: Despicable Me 4
metas.description: Gru, Lucy, Margo, Edith, and Agnes welcome a new member to the family, Gru Jr., who is intent on tormenting his dad. Gru faces a new nemesis in Maxime Le Mal and his girlfriend Valentina, and the family is forced to go on the run.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: Minions Stuart, Kevin, and Bob are recruited by Scarlet Overkill, a supervillain who, alongside her inventor husband Herb, hatches a plot to take over the world.

metas.name: Minions: The Rise of Gru
metas.description: The untold story of one twelve-year-old's dream to become the world's greatest supervillain.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenaged daughter.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania 2
metas.description: Dracula and his friends try to bring out the monster in his half human, half vampire grandson in order to keep Mavis from leaving the hotel.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation
metas.description: Count Dracula and company participate in a cruise for sea-loving monsters, unaware that their boat is being commandeered by the monster-hating Van Helsing family.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania 4: Transformania
metas.description: After one experiment, Johnny turns into a monster and everyone else becomes human. Now it has to be seen whether they will be able to reverse this experiment.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: An eccentric inventor is regarded as a failure within his isolated community until he creates a machine that can make it rain food.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
metas.description: Flint Lockwood now works at The Live Corp Company for his idol Chester V. But he's forced to leave his post when he learns that his most infamous machine is still operational, and is churning out menacing food-animal hybrids.

metas.name: Rio
metas.description: When Blu, a domesticated macaw from small-town Minnesota, meets the fiercely independent Jewel, he takes off on an adventure to Rio de Janeiro with the bird of his dreams.

metas.name: Rio 2
metas.description: It's a jungle out there for Blu, Jewel, and their three kids after they're hurtled from Rio de Janeiro to the wilds of the Amazon. As Blu tries to fit in, he goes beak-to-beak with the vengeful Nigel and meets his father-in-law.

metas.name: Open Season
metas.description: Boog, a domesticated 900lb. Grizzly bear, finds himself stranded in the woods 3 days before Open Season. Forced to rely on Elliot, a fast-talking mule deer, the two form an unlikely friendship and must quickly rally other forest a...

metas.name: Open Season 2
metas.description: After falling head over hooves in love with Giselle, Elliot's road to the altar takes a slight detour when Mr. Weenie is 'kidnapped' by his human owners. A rescue mission starts. Oh, and there's also a group of pampered pets.

metas.name: Open Season 3
metas.description: Boog's friends rally to bring him home from a Russian traveling circus.

metas.name: Surf's Up
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes look at the annual Penguin World Surfing Championship, and its newest participant, up-and-comer Cody Maverick.

metas.name: Robots
metas.description: In a robot world, a young idealistic inventor travels to the big city to join his inspiration's company, only to find himself opposing its sinister new management.

metas.name: Horton Hears a Who!
metas.description: Horton the Elephant struggles to protect a microscopic community from his neighbors who refuse to believe it exists.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: Snoopy embarks upon his greatest mission as he and his team take to the skies to pursue their archnemesis, while his best pal Charlie Brown begins his own epic quest back home to win the love of his life.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle, who wants to ascend the throne himself.

metas.name: The Lion King 2: Simba's Pride
metas.description: Simba's daughter is the key to a resolution of a bitter feud between Simba's pride and the outcast pride led by the mate of Scar.

metas.name: The Lion King 3: Hakuna Matata
metas.description: Timon the meerkat and Pumbaa the warthog retell the story of The Lion King (1994) from their own perspective.

metas.name: Aladdin
metas.description: A kind-hearted street urchin and a power-hungry Grand Vizier vie for a magic lamp that has the power to make their deepest wishes come true.

metas.name: The Return of Jafar
metas.description: Jafar comes for revenge on Aladdin, using a foolish thief and Iago's treachery to find a way back into power.

metas.name: Aladdin and the King of Thieves
metas.description: The King of Thieves disrupts Aladdin and Jasmine's long-anticipated wedding, looking for an oracle that will lead him to an even bigger treasure. His true identity causes trouble for Aladdin.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch
metas.description: A young and parentless girl adopts a 'dog' from the local pound, completely unaware that it's supposedly a dangerous scientific experiment that's taken refuge on Earth and is now hiding from its creator and those who see it as a m...

metas.name: Stitch! The Movie
metas.description: Stitch, an alien living on Earth disguised as a dog with his human family, continues his adventures when he discovers that the alien family he never knew he had is now in Hawaii, being hunted down by galactic forces.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch 2: Stitch Has a Glitch
metas.description: A malfunction threatens to destroy Stitch and his friendship with Lilo!

metas.name: Leroy & Stitch
metas.description: New circumstances forces Lilo and her alien friends to part ways while Gantu and Dr. Van Hamsterviel create the Stitch clone, Leroy, in order to capture all of the experiments and take over the galaxy.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: Emperor Kuzco is turned into a llama by his ex-administrator Yzma, and must now regain his throne and his human form with the help of Pacha, a gentle llama herder.

metas.name: Kronk's New Groove
metas.description: Kronk desperately tries to find ways to impress his dad, whom he can never please. But when things go wrong, Kronk kicks into comical gear and discovers the true riches in life are his friends and being "true to your groove".

metas.name: Atlantis: The Lost Empire
metas.description: In 1914, a young linguist is tasked by an intrepid group of mercenaries with deciphering an ancient text that will lead them to the lost city of Atlantis.

metas.name: Atlantis: Milo's Return
metas.description: Milo and Kida reunite with their friends to investigate strange occurances around the world that seem to have links to the secrets of Atlantis.

metas.name: Treasure Planet
metas.description: Jim Hawkins is a teenager who finds the map of a great treasure hidden by a space pirate. Together with some friends, he sets off in a large spaceship, shaped like a caravel, on his quest.

metas.name: Tarzan
metas.description: A man raised by gorillas must decide where he really belongs when he discovers he is a human.

metas.name: Tarzan 2: The Legend Begins
metas.description: The tale of Tarzan's misadventures as a boy as he searches for his true identity and the meaning of family.

metas.name: Tarzan & Jane
metas.description: After being married an entire year, Jane thinks back on some of her and Tarzan's adventures as she searches for something special to mark the occasion with.

metas.name: Hercules
metas.description: The son of Zeus and Hera is stripped of his immortality as an infant and must become a true hero in order to reclaim it.

metas.name: Mulan
metas.description: To save her father from death in the army, a young maiden secretly goes in his place and becomes one of China's greatest heroines in the process.

metas.name: Mulan II
metas.description: While preparing for their wedding, Shang and Mulan are suddenly sent off on a secret mission. Mushu starts to meddle, and a surprise attack by Mongolians doesn't help either.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: Ralph is tired of playing the role of a bad guy and embarks on a journey to become a video game hero. But he accidentally lets loose a deadly enemy that threatens the entire arcade.

metas.name: Ralph Breaks the Internet
metas.description: On a quest to save the video game 'Sugar Rush' and to find a replacement, Ralph and his best friend Vanellope travel to the World Wide Web through a Wi-Fi router they find at the arcade.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: A special bond develops between plus-sized inflatable robot Baymax and prodigy Hiro Hamada, who together team up with a group of friends to form a band of high-tech heroes.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: Fearless optimist Anna teams up with rugged mountain man Kristoff and his loyal reindeer Sven in an epic journey to find Anna's sister Elsa, whose icy powers have trapped the kingdom of Arendelle in eternal winter.

metas.name: Frozen II
metas.description: Anna, Elsa, Kristoff, Olaf and Sven leave Arendelle to travel to the ancient autumnal forest of an enchanted land. They set out to find the origin of Elsa's powers in order to save their kingdom.

metas.name: Tangled
metas.description: The magically long-haired Rapunzel has spent her entire life in a tower, but now that a runaway thief has stumbled upon her, she is about to discover the world for the first time, and who she really is.

metas.name: Zootopia
metas.description: In a city of anthropomorphic animals, a rookie bunny cop and a cynical con artist fox must work together to uncover a conspiracy.

metas.name: Moana
metas.description: In ancient Polynesia, when a terrible curse incurred by the demigod Maui reaches Moana's island, she answers the Ocean's call to seek out Maui to set things right.

metas.name: Encanto
metas.description: An extraordinary family, the Madrigals, live hidden in the mountains of Colombia, in a magical house called an Encanto. The magic of the Encanto has blessed every child in the family with a unique gift - every child except one, Mi...

metas.name: Brother Bear
metas.description: When a young Inuit hunter needlessly kills a bear, he is magically changed into a bear himself as punishment with a talkative cub being his only guide to changing back.

metas.name: Brother Bear 2
metas.description: An old female friend of Kenai needs his help on a quest, much to Koda's growing consternation.

metas.name: Meet the Robinsons
metas.description: Lewis is a brilliant inventor who meets mysterious stranger named Wilbur Robinson, whisking Lewis away in a time machine and together they team up to track down Bowler Hat Guy in a showdown that ends with an unexpected twist of fate.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: The canine star of a fictional sci-fi/action show that believes his powers are real embarks on a cross country trek to save his co-star from a threat he believes is just as real.

metas.name: The Little Mermaid
metas.description: A mermaid princess makes a Faustian bargain in an attempt to become human and win a prince's love.

metas.name: The Little Mermaid 2: Return to the Sea
metas.description: To protect her from a sea witch, Ariel's daughter is not allowed in the ocean; but when she becomes 12, she runs away to an adventure under the sea.

metas.name: Beauty and the Beast
metas.description: A prince cursed to spend his days as a hideous monster sets out to regain his humanity by earning a young woman's love.

metas.name: The Jungle Book
metas.description: Bagheera the Panther and Baloo the Bear have a difficult time trying to convince a boy to leave the jungle for human civilization.

metas.name: The Jungle Book 2
metas.description: Mowgli, missing the jungle and his old friends, runs away from the man village unaware of the danger he's in by going back to the wild.

metas.name: Peter Pan
metas.description: Wendy and her brothers are whisked away to the magical world of Neverland with the hero of their stories, Peter Pan.

metas.name: Return to Never Land
metas.description: In London during World War II, this is the story of Wendy's daughter, Jane, who is kidnapped by Captain Hook and Peter Pan must come to the rescue.

metas.name: One Hundred and One Dalmatians
metas.description: When a litter of Dalmatian puppies are abducted by the minions of Cruella De Vil, the owners must find them before she uses them for a diabolical fashion statement.

metas.name: 101 Dalmatians 2: Patch's London Adventure
metas.description: Being one of 101 takes its toll on Patch, who doesn't feel unique. When he's accidentally left behind on moving day, he meets his idol, Thunderbolt, who enlists him on a publicity campaign.

metas.name: The Rescuers Down Under
metas.description: R.A.S. agents Miss Bianca and Bernard race to Australia to save a little boy and a rare golden eagle from a murderous poacher.

metas.name: The Fox and the Hound
metas.description: A fox named Tod and a hound named Copper vow to be best friends forever. But as Copper grows into a hunting dog, their unlikely friendship faces the ultimate test.

metas.name: Bambi
metas.description: The story of a young deer growing up in the forest.

metas.name: Bambi and the Great Prince of the Forest
metas.description: The story of Bambi growing up in the care of his father, The Great Prince of the Forest.

metas.name: Cinderella
metas.description: When Cinderella's cruel stepmother prevents her from attending the Royal Ball, she gets some unexpected help from the lovable mice Gus and Jaq and from her Fairy Godmother.

metas.name: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
metas.description: In this collection of animated shorts based on the stories and characters by A.A. Milne, Winnie the Pooh, a honey-loving teddy bear, embarks on some eccentric adventures.

metas.name: Winnie the Pooh
metas.description: While searching for honey, Pooh and his friends embark on an adventure to find Eeyore's missing tail and rescue Christopher Robin from an unknown monster called The Backson.

metas.name: The Nightmare Before Christmas
metas.description: Jack Skellington, king of Halloween Town, discovers Christmas Town, but his attempts to bring Christmas to his home causes confusion.

metas.name: The Iron Giant
metas.description: A young boy befriends a giant robot from outer space that a paranoid government agent wants to destroy.

metas.name: Monster House
metas.description: Three teens discover that their neighbor's house is really a living, breathing, scary monster.

metas.name: Coraline
metas.description: Wandering her rambling old house in her boring new town, a young girl discovers a hidden door to a strangely idealized version of her life that seems too good to be true.

metas.name: The Simpsons Movie
metas.description: After Homer pollutes the town's water supply, Springfield is encased in a gigantic dome by the EPA and the Simpsons are declared fugitives.
A rag doll that awakens in a postapocalyptic future holds the key to humanity's salvation.

metas.name: Rango
metas.description: Rango is an ordinary chameleon who accidentally winds up in the town of Dirt, a lawless outpost in the Wild West in desperate need of a new sheriff.

metas.name: The Adventures of Tintin
metas.description: Intrepid reporter Tintin and Captain Haddock set off on a treasure hunt for a sunken ship commanded by Haddock's ancestor.
